channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Trump’s trade ‘war’ with Canada has Carney facing his biggest test yet
item.dc:creator: Ellen Francis
item.description: The Canadian prime minister has said his government will match U.S. tariffs "dollar for dollar."

item.title: U.S. withdraws from military exercises with South Korea set for next month
item.dc:creator: Sammy Westfall
item.description: The move comes as the Iran war strains U.S. military resources in Asia.

item.title: Trump’s visa ban on 75 countries struck down by federal judge
item.dc:creator: Teo Armus
item.description: A federal judge said the indefinite pause, which affected nationals of countries in every corner of the globe, ran afoul of antidiscrimination protections.

item.title: Pence says U.S.-Canada trade fight adds to affordability concerns for economy
item.dc:creator: Sammy Westfall
item.description: “I think the last thing we need right now, as our economy is getting back on its feet, is a trade war with Canada,” the former vice president told CNN.

item.title: U.S.-Canada breakdown shows limits of Trump’s aggressive trade strategy
item.dc:creator: David J. Lynch
item.description: “It’s a big setback,” one analyst said, noting that other countries unhappy with the president’s trade deals are probably watching closely.
